blocks.text: Terms of Use mein aam taur par kuch common clauses (aam shartein) hoti hain jo provider aur user dono ki hifazat ke liye banai jati hain. Yeh clauses hain:

items: User Obligations (user ki zimmedariyan): yeh batati hain ke user se kya umeed ki jati hai (user ko kya karna hai). Misal: Pakistan mein Careem jaisi ride-sharing apps ki shart hai ke user sahi (valid) phone number de, aur service ko safar ke ilawa kisi aur kaam ke liye ghalat istemal na kare.

Limitations of Liability (zimmedari ki hadd): yeh batati hain ke kuch ghalat ho jaye to provider ki liability (zimmedari) kitni limited (sirf ek hadd tak) hai. Misal: Pakistan mein agar aap online banking istemal karte hain aur app kuch der ke liye band ho jaye, to bank ki Terms of Use aam taur par aisi rukawat par bank ki zimmedari limited kar deti hain.

Privacy and Data Use (privacy aur data ka istemal): yeh batati hain ke company user ka data kaise jama (collect), istemal aur mehfooz karegi. Aaj data privacy ki fikr barh rahi hai, is liye yeh khaas taur par ahem hai. Misal: WhatsApp jaisi messaging app ki Terms of Use batati hain ke aap ke messages kaise store aur mehfooz kiye jate hain.

Intellectual Property Rights (apni banai hui cheez ka malik hone ka haq): yeh provider ki apni cheezon ki hifazat karti hain, jaise logos, software aur doosri proprietary cheezein (jo sirf company ki apni hain). Misal: Pakistani news website yeh shart rakh sakti hai ke user us ke articles ijazat ke baghair copy aur distribute (aage baantna) na kare, ta ke us ka content ghalat istemal ya ghalat tareeqe se pesh na ho.

Termination of Service (service khatam karna): yeh batati hai ke provider kin halaat mein user ka access (service istemal karne ki ijazat) khatam kar sakta hai. Misal: Facebook jaise social media platforms ki shart hai ke jo accounts community standards (platform ke rules) todte hain, jaise nafrat bhari baatein (hate speech) ya ghalat maloomat phailate hain, unhein suspend (kuch waqt ke liye band) ya terminate (hamesha ke liye band) kiya ja sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: MCQ 1: Kaunsi cheez aam taur par Terms of Use ki common clauses mein shamil NAHI? MCQ 2: “Limitations of Liability” clause kya karti hai?
blocks.explanation: MCQ 1: (c) Product advertising; baqi teen (user obligations, privacy and data use, termination of service) is topic ki clauses hain. MCQ 2: (b) kuch ghalat ho jaye to company ki zimmedari limited karti hai. (Kitab ki answer key yahan 1 b aur 2 a deti hai, jo text se mel nahi khati; Exercise ka lesson dekhein.)

blocks.prompt: Terms of Use ki common clauses samjhaiye aur bataiye ke yeh provider aur user dono ko kaise bachati hain. (Long question 1)
blocks.explanation: User Obligations: user ko batati hain ke us se kya umeed hai (jaise Careem par sahi phone number), aur ghalat istemal rok kar provider aur doosre users ko bachati hain. Limitations of Liability: provider ko kuch der ki rukawat (jaise bank app band hona) par bare claims (nuqsan ke daawon) se bachati hain, aur user ko pehle se bata deti hain ke kis cheez ki zimmedari provider nahi lega. Privacy and Data Use: user ko batati hain ke us ka data kaise jama, istemal aur mehfooz hoga (jaise WhatsApp messages), aur provider ke liye data ke istemal ke saaf rules banati hain. Intellectual Property Rights: provider ke logos, software aur articles ko copy hone se bachati hain, aur user ko batati hain ke kya copy nahi karna. Termination of Service: batati hai ke account kab band ho sakta hai (jaise Facebook par hate speech), jis se platform aur us ke users mehfooz rehte hain. Saaf clauses dono ke rights aur zimmedariyan saaf kar ke jhagre se bachati hain.

items: Paanch common clauses: User Obligations, Limitations of Liability, Privacy and Data Use, Intellectual Property Rights, Termination of Service.
Misalein: Careem, online banking app, WhatsApp, Pakistani news website, Facebook.
